extendedDescription:
BitMsika – Spend Bitcoin Anywhere in Malawi

BitMsika lets you use your Bitcoin in the real world by converting it instantly into mobile money. Powered by the Lightning Network, you can send Bitcoin and have it received as TNM Mpamba or Airtel Money anywhere in Malawi — fast, simple, and low-cost.

No banks, no delays. Just seamless payments from Bitcoin to mobile money.

What you can do:
Send Bitcoin and deliver funds as mobile money instantly
Pay anyone in Malawi using TNM Mpamba or Airtel Money
Enjoy fast, low-fee transactions with Lightning
Convert Bitcoin into spendable Kwacha


BitMsika bridges Bitcoin and everyday payments — making it easy to live on Bitcoin in Malawi.
